title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Treasury Cross-Servicing and Credit Bureau Reporting Terms
content:
Thresholds, fees and offset limits that apply once a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** becomes delinquent, by debt type.

| Debt type | Referred after delinquency of more than (calendar days) | Smallest balance referred (USD) | Treasury cross-servicing fee (percent of balance referred) | Collectible from federal tax refunds once referred |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 120 | 25.00 | 32.0 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 120 | 25.00 | 32.0 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 120 | 25.00 | 32.0 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 120 | 25.00 | 32.0 | Yes |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 120 | 25.00 | 32.0 | Yes |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 120 | 25.00 | 32.0 | Yes |

| Debt type | Social Security offset, most of a monthly benefit (percent) | Monthly Social Security amount protected (USD) | Federal salary offset, most of disposable pay (percent) | Administrative wage garnishment, most of disposable pay (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 15 | 750.00 | 15 | 15 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 15 | 750.00 | 15 | 15 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 15 | 750.00 | 15 | 15 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 15 | 750.00 | 15 | 15 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 15 | 750.00 | 15 | 15 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 15 | 750.00 | 15 | 15 |

| Debt type | Reported to consumer credit bureaus when delinquent | Reported once this many calendar days have passed since the notice |
|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | No | 0 (not reported) |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | No | 0 (not reported) |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | No | 0 (not reported) |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | No | 0 (not reported) |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | No | 0 (not reported) |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | Yes | 60 |

## Reading the terms

- The fee is a percentage of the balance referred: on a hypothetical referred balance of 1,000.00 USD, Treasury adds 32.0 percent, that is 320.00 USD.
- The Social Security limits work together: no more than 15 percent of a monthly Social Security benefit, and never from the first 750.00 USD of it.
- Only the Home Loan Guaranty Debt is a type reported to the consumer credit bureaus; its reporting date is 60 calendar days after the notice. The other five types are never reported, and the figure 0 in their row carries no reporting date.
